subsystem: API19 SurfaceView child Surface and SurfaceHolder callbacks
observed_discontinuity: Unchanged Frozen Bubble installed org.jfedor.frozenbubble.GameView and the host Decor entered performDraw. The SurfaceView child had no SurfaceHolder lifecycle.
required_semantics: SurfaceView.getHolder returns a holder whose Surface is a different object from the ViewRoot window Surface.
addCallback stores the callback and does not fire surfaceCreated.
The child Surface is created only when the window and the view are visible and the view frame is positive.
surfaceCreated runs once for that creation, then surfaceChanged runs with the view size and PixelFormat.RGB_565.
A later traversal with the same size and format does not repeat either callback.
A hidden view or a non-positive frame does not create a Surface or fire callbacks.
Allocation failure leaves the holder invalid and does not invalidate the root Surface.

differences.description: API19 SurfaceView.updateWindow creates a child window Surface after mHaveFrame and dispatches SurfaceHolder callbacks. AGR's host Decor performDraw had no child Surface owner.
differences.relevance: The inflated GameView could not receive surfaceCreated, so the app never obtained a valid content Surface.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: API19 SurfaceView.updateWindow creates a child Surface and dispatches surfaceCreated then surfaceChanged once the view has a positive frame and is visible; AGR reached host Decor performDraw with the inflated GameView child and no SurfaceHolder lifecycle.

evidence.artifact: Pinned android-4.4.4_r2 SurfaceView.java, SurfaceHolder.java, and PixelFormat.java hashes in framework.view.surface_view

The closed explicit first traversal still ends at handoff.viewroot_surface_ready.

next_action: Do not rerun discovery 35683118511 and do not reopen SurfaceView. lockCanvas is framework-surface-holder-canvas.json.
host_adaptation: The child Surface is an in-process buffer owned by the SurfaceView holder. It is not the ViewRoot window Surface and it is not a SurfaceFlinger child window. IWindowSession.addToDisplayWithoutInputChannel is not a separate process. A callback exception is recorded and cleared so the host Decor performDraw still runs.
